description: Show or hide the wall-thickness heatmap on the active part, in the part local frame. on true paints each triangle with the viridis ramp from thin (0.6× nominal) through nominal to thick (1.5× nominal) and shows that legend. on false removes the skin so face paint and the part colour show again. Omit on to toggle. Read-only. A geometric view of the mold-analysis wall field, not a stress plot and not a quote. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

on.description: true shows the thickness heatmap. false restores paint and the part colour. Omit to toggle.

name: mold_wall_map
